title: socketRequest retries create-room and join-room after timeouts that the server may have already processed
test: tests/mediasoupClient.test.js: 'socketRequest emits create-room exactly once when the acknowledgement times out', 'socketRequest emits join-room exactly once when the acknowledgement times out', 'socketRequest does not resend create-room or join-room after a disconnect that follows the emit', 'socketRequest throws a server error that says "timed out" without retrying it', 'socketRequest does not retry server errors that mention a lost or failed connection', 'socketRequest keeps the phase tag when a server response carries its own phase field', 'socketRequest tags an empty acknowledgement as a server failure and does not retry it', 'socketRequest tags a failed connect with the connect phase', 'socketRequest tags a connect that never reports an error with the connect phase'; guards that passed before and after: get-media-init is still retried after an ack timeout and after a disconnect following the emit, reclaim-host and leave-room are still retried after a timeout, create-room and join-room are still retried after a connect failure before the emit (emitted once)
proof: On the unchanged code (84c0dd9) node --test tests/mediasoupClient.test.js ran 18 tests: 9 passed (the 5 existing and 4 guards) and 9 new tests failed. create-room and join-room were emitted twice after an ack timeout (expected 1, actual 2) and twice after a disconnect following the emit; a server error 'operation timed out' (and 'Connection lost ...', 'Socket connect failed ...', 'Socket is not connected ...') on create-room, join-room, get-media-init, reclaim-host and leave-room was sent again (expected 1, actual 2); errors carried no phase tag (err.phase undefined). After the fix: 18/18 pass; npm test 784/784; lint and typecheck clean. Failing output kept in the scratchpad as client-TASK-077-before.txt. One existing test pinned the defect: 'socketRequest retries a timed-out idempotent request and accepts the later acknowledgement' retried join-room after a timeout; it now uses get-media-init (the idempotent event its name describes) and is otherwise unchanged. The issue also names reclaim-host and leave-room; they stay retryable after a timeout or a disconnect because lib/socket.js handles a repeat safely (reclaim-host rechecks the host token for the same room, leave-room with no room answers success), and a test pins that.
